name: INMP441 Omnidirectional Digital I2S Microphone Breakout Board
core_ic: INMP441 MEMS Microphone with integrated 24-bit I2S ADC and decimation filter
sensor_element: Bottom-port acoustic capacitive MEMS sensor with silicon membrane

electrical_specs.frequency_response_hz: 60 Hz - 15,000 Hz (extended infrasonic roll-off down to ~15-20 Hz detectable)
electrical_specs.interface_standard: Industry standard 24-bit I2S digital audio bus

physical_pins.label: SCK
physical_pins.notes: Serial clock supplied by ESP32-S3 I2S master peripheral (1.024 MHz at 16kHz sampling).

physical_pins.label: WS
physical_pins.notes: Frame sync clock supplied by ESP32-S3 (16 kHz audio frame rate).

physical_pins.label: L/R
physical_pins.notes: Pulled LOW to ground selects Left audio channel for mono recording mode.

physical_pins.label: SD
physical_pins.notes: Tri-state digital PCM sample stream output sampled on trailing clock edge.

physical_pins.label: VDD
physical_pins.notes: 3.3V power input, decouple with 0.1uF ceramic capacitor close to board.

controls_and_features.name: Acoustic Port
controls_and_features.desc: Circular acoustic aperture on underside of MEMS package admitting atmospheric pressure waves.

controls_and_features.name: Integrated 24-bit ADC
controls_and_features.desc: Sigma-Delta converter and anti-aliasing decimation filter eliminating need for analog preamp circuits.

controls_and_features.name: Internal Pull-Downs
controls_and_features.desc: Ensures clean floating bus recovery between words.

role_in_prw_wild.purpose: Acoustic monitoring of elephant low-frequency vocalizations (rumbles ~14-25 Hz fundamental) and breaking branches/brush noises.
role_in_prw_wild.strengths: Long propagation range (hundreds of meters for low-frequency sound), direct digital stream with high SNR, zero analog degradation over cable.
role_in_prw_wild.limitations: Wind shear noise across microphone port requires acoustic foam windscreen; acoustic events can be non-continuous when elephant moves quietly.
